email.subject: Urgent: Payroll Update Required - Action Needed Today
email.body:
Dear Finance Team,

We have detected an issue with your company's payroll direct deposit information. For security compliance, we need you to update the banking details for employee payroll immediately.

Please click the secure link below to verify and update the account information:
https://payroll-services-xyz.com/verify-account

This must be completed within 24 hours to avoid payroll disruption for your employees. Failure to act will result in delayed salary deposits.

If you have any questions, reply to this email or contact our support team at support@payroll-services-xyz.com.

Regards,
Payroll Services XYZ
Compliance Department
